basic_info.description: Ideally situated just blocks from Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park, 4532 Irving Street presents an intriguing  opportunity for investors and owner-occupants alike.  Consisting of four 2-bedroom1-bathroom units, each offering generous layouts and excellent natural light. The property includes four garage parking spaces, additional storage, shared outdoor patio and laundry hook-ups for additional revenue and tenant convenience.  Recent capital improvements include roof and double pane vinyl windows.  Fully occupied, perfect for investors looking for a long term growth potential with tremendous upside potential (7.21% Market Cap - 10.15 Market GRM)  - OR - for a savvy owner-occupier wanting to live in one unit while offsetting their mortgage with rental income from the three units.  Don't miss this chance to invest in The Outer Sunset,  one of San Franciscos last hidden gems; with endless outdoor recreation, vibrant and trendy eateries and stunning natural beauty.
